title: Tate McRae launches namesake fragrance brand in partnership with Scent Beauty
summary: Canadian singer, songwriter, and dancer Tate McRae is entering into the fragrance industry with the launch of Tate 01, created in partnership with New York City-headquartered Scent Beauty, Inc. (AllSaints; Dolly Parton; Kylie Minogue; Megan Moroney; Sabrina Carpenter; Stetson). Crafted in collaboration with Givaudan master perfumers Adriana Medina and Antoine Maisondieu, Tate 01 is described as “a sophisticated approach to second-skin fragrance.” Anchored by Iso E Super, a synthetic... - Industry buzz
